payload.core_composition_summary: Sort points by (x,y,z) then greedily pair by shared x,y, then shared x, then remainder.
payload.rationale: Solution first sorts points, then applies a multi-level greedy pairing that exploits sorted order to guarantee no other points within bounding boxes.
